fixed_findings: Arm publication and timer rollback now take the same private flock; a timer firing during arm waits and removes the final published override rather than allowing arm to recreate it after rollback.

Manual rollback executes the root-protected idempotent rollback synchronously while the timer is still armed; it only stops the timer after successful restoration. Failure does not remove the timer first.
checked_boundaries: Root-only; UID1000 must resolve to t736; fresh state/dropin and absent same-name timer/service are required.
System-manager timer is created and confirmed active before the candidate environment and user-unit dropin are published.

Only the UID1000 optional environment file exists; user-manager %U expansion leaves GDM and other UID managers without candidate environment. Public config is readable0755/0644; rollback script and saved GDM configuration stay beneath root-private0700.
Arm does not restart or replace a GNOME session. System libraries and the vendor graphics directory are not modified. Candidate prefix must already have separately verified artifacts.

Rollback removes only the two known transient config files, restores saved daemon.conf, reloads the target user manager and restarts display-manager with bounded command waits. Successful hash check and restart precede completion marker.
The common lock plus completion marker serialize timer/manual rollback and avoid duplicate restarts after success. A timeout/error before completion does not claim restoration succeeded.
operational_boundary: The separately authorized controller action that temporarily changes daemon.conf and starts a session must take the same /run/t736-sbc-ac42/private/lock, first reject rollback.complete and ensure the timer remains valid. Otherwise external activation after timer expiry could reintroduce temporary GDM configuration. This guard prepares only; it does not serialize unrelated later shell commands.
limits: No systemd timer or GDM session was started by this reviewer; bash -n is syntax validation only.
The review does not verify candidate ELF/typelib loader identity or physically displayed frames.
After controller-triggered temporary autologin, restore daemon.conf immediately while retaining the timer during bounded evidence collection.
Do not publish saved GDM contents, credentials or authentication/session logs.
